body_text:
Every holomorphic function is analytic. If $f$ is holomorphic on
an open set containing the closed disk $\overline{D(z_0,r)}$, then
for $|z-z_0|<r$,
$f(z)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}f^{(n)}(z_0)(z-z_0)^n/n!$. This theorem
has no direct real-variable analogue: real differentiability of
every order does not imply real analyticity.
